summary: Empery Digital Inc. filed an 8-K detailing its indirect 25% equity interest in EMHU, LLC, which agreed to purchase a Midwest property, expected to close in Q3 2026. The company will fund its $65 million committed investment from balance sheet, not issuing equity at current prices. A non-binding LOI with a potential tenant may lead to a lease for data center conversion. This is a routine update on previously announced capital allocation, not a special situation event.
